column1: # Unit claims, so two people or agents do not decompile the same unit twice.
# Claim a unit by adding a row before you start, and set done when you stop,
# whether you finished or not. One claimant per unit. A row is advisory: it
# records intent, and nothing in the build reads this file.
# state: open (claimed, in progress) | done (claimant stopped)
# left:  INCLUDE_ASM functions and retail code bytes when the row was written
